stories.h: Man killed, woman wounded in Everett shooting
stories.s: A man in his 50s died and a woman in her 40s was hospitalized after a shooting around 3:45 a.m. Monday in the 6400 block of Highland Drive. Police believe those involved knew each other. No arrest has been reported.

stories.h: Jared Mead launches run for Snohomish County Executive
stories.s: County Councilmember Jared Mead announced a campaign for county executive. The seat opens in 2027 when Dave Somers reaches his three-term limit.

stories.h: Accused Everett boat thief released after third arrest
stories.s: Nathan Pings, 21, is accused of stealing three boats in about two weeks. After his third arrest, a judge released him without bail over prosecutors' objections. He is due back in court Dec. 9.

coming.h: Tulalip Lights & Ice opens for the season
coming.s: The holiday lights display at the Tulalip Amphitheatre opens, with lights coming on at 5 p.m.
Holiday market in downtown Edmonds runs 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Saturday.
